task.title: Wire initial-enrollment forms and one-time recovery materials
task.input: M3-T2 secured existing enroll backend, M3-T6 sign-in page, and M1 unique tokens.
task.output: /admin-enroll forms, an initial-enrollment entry on sign-in, and in-memory valid-token import/URL clearing.
task.accept: 1) Entry: First authenticator setup (login-enroll) on /admin-login -> /admin-enroll. Data sources: POST /api/auth-admin/enroll and POST /api/auth-admin/enroll/confirm. A real existing-token/email/password form yields the URI, then confirmation with the next unused new code yields one-time recovery-code display. Before confirmation the passwordless toggle stays false; wrong/expired/replayed enrollment changes nothing (E-05, E-08). 2) Keep token/URI/codes only in memory. Immediately clear a historical fragment after import and clear secrets on pagehide. Do not reuse the confirmed code for sign-in; return to login and actually sign in with a new code in the next step. Email alone without a valid token cannot enroll (E-10). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.
